title: Animals And Birds Arabic Summary For The 7th Degree Of The 1st Station

questions.question: According to the passage, what do all kinds of animals and birds agree on together?
questions.answer: They all testify that only Allah is worthy of worship.

questions.question: What picture is used to help us imagine the whole earth giving this message?
questions.answer: The earth is described like one huge person speaking with one voice.

questions.question: Who receives this testimony from the earth in the passage?
questions.answer: The people or beings in the heavens receive it.

questions.question: How well did the traveler understand what he saw?
questions.answer: He understood it fully and clearly.

questions.question: Which two large groups of living things are especially named as praising and witnessing?
questions.answer: Animals and birds.

questions.question: Besides their voices, what other parts of animals are said to show this witness?
questions.answer: Their senses, abilities, limbs, organs, and other body parts.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the way animals are created?
questions.answer: It teaches that they are brought into existence by Allah’s will, purpose, and wisdom.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the differences among animals’ forms?
questions.answer: Their many forms are organized, different from one another, and very varied.

questions.question: From what simple beginnings do these many animal forms come?
questions.answer: They come from eggs and drops of sperm that look the same or very similar.

questions.question: What contrast is made between the starting points and the results?
questions.answer: The starting points are limited and alike, but the results are countless and diverse.

questions.question: What idea about Allah is supported by this united witness of animals and birds?
questions.answer: It supports Allah’s necessary existence and His oneness.

questions.question: What main lesson should a student take from this passage?
questions.answer: All creation, even animals and birds, points people to Allah through its order, design, and variety.

questions.question: What is the main message shared by the three truths mentioned at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: Together they show that all animal kinds witness to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: Why does the passage say this witness is strong?
questions.answer: Because it comes from the agreement of many signs all pointing to the same truth.

questions.question: How is the earth described when all these creatures are giving their witness?
questions.answer: It is shown as if it were one giant being declaring belief in Allah.

questions.question: In the passage, what are animals and birds doing besides simply living?
questions.answer: They are praising Allah and showing signs of Him.

questions.question: What do the creatures’ senses and abilities act like in the passage?
questions.answer: They act like meaningful words that tell about their Creator.

questions.question: What do the creatures’ body parts act like in the passage?
questions.answer: They act like clear and complete signs.

questions.question: Which three qualities are connected with creation in the passage?
questions.answer: Will, purpose, and wisdom.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest by mentioning decoration and distinction among creatures?
questions.answer: It suggests that their beauty and differences are intentional, not random.

questions.question: Why is it important that many forms come from similar eggs and sperm?
questions.answer: It shows amazing power and planning, since very different creatures come from similar beginnings.

questions.question: Are the beginnings described as endless or limited? Explain.
questions.answer: They are limited, because the passage says they are few and bounded.

questions.question: What belief does the traveler reach after seeing all this?
questions.answer: He realizes clearly that these signs point to Allah alone.

questions.question: Who is said to be testifying together in this passage?
questions.answer: All the different species of animals are testifying together.

questions.question: What are they testifying to?
questions.answer: They are testifying that there is no god but Allah.

questions.question: What does the traveler do after seeing this great witness?
questions.answer: He understands its meaning completely.

questions.question: What title is given to this statement in the passage?
questions.answer: It is called the Seventh Degree of the First Station.

questions.question: How do animals and birds praise and bear witness according to the passage?
questions.answer: They do it through the signs found in their senses, powers, and bodies.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the condition of these signs in the creatures?
questions.answer: They are balanced, ordered, complete, and clear in what they show.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about bringing animals into existence?
questions.answer: It says they are created through Allah’s will.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the special features and beauty of creatures?
questions.answer: Their differences and beauty are made on purpose.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the shaping of creatures?
questions.answer: Their forms and measurements are made with wisdom.

questions.question: How are the many forms of animals described?
questions.answer: They are orderly, different, varied, and beyond counting.

questions.question: What beginning materials are named for these creatures?
questions.answer: Eggs and drops of sperm are named.

questions.question: What big conclusion comes from the whole passage?
questions.answer: The variety, order, and design in animals and birds all point to Allah’s existence and oneness.

questions.question: What united message comes from all animal species in the passage?
questions.answer: Their united message is that Allah alone is the true God.

questions.question: Why does the passage compare the earth to a great human being?
questions.answer: To show that all the creatures on earth seem to join into one huge testimony.

questions.question: Where is this testimony being sent?
questions.answer: It is being conveyed to the dwellers of the heavens.

questions.question: Which creatures are directly mentioned in the formal statement that follows?
questions.answer: Animals and birds are directly mentioned.

questions.question: What inner parts of creatures are included in their witness?
questions.answer: Their senses, abilities, and subtle powers are included.

questions.question: What outer parts of creatures are included in their witness?
questions.answer: Their limbs, organs, and bodily tools are included.

questions.question: What can we infer from both inner and outer parts being mentioned?
questions.answer: Every part of a creature points to its Creator, not just one part.

questions.question: What three actions of Allah are highlighted in relation to creatures?
questions.answer: Bringing into being, giving distinct features and beauty, and shaping them in proper measure.

questions.question: What three qualities guide those actions?
questions.answer: They are guided by will, purpose, and wisdom.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention similar eggs and sperm?
questions.answer: To show that many different creatures come from simple and similar starting points.

questions.question: In the passage, what do the three truths agree on?
questions.answer: They agree that animals together bear witness to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: How is the earth’s testimony described in a way that matches its size?
questions.answer: It is described as speaking in a way suitable for something so vast.

questions.question: What are animals and birds doing toward Allah in the passage?
questions.answer: They are praising Him and showing proof of Him.

questions.question: What do their well-arranged senses and powers show?
questions.answer: They show order and meaning in how they were made.

questions.question: What do their complete body parts show?
questions.answer: They show careful making and a clear purpose.

questions.question: How does the passage connect creation with will?
questions.answer: It says creatures are brought into being by will, not without choice.

questions.question: How does the passage connect distinction and beauty with purpose?
questions.answer: It says their special differences and adornment are done intentionally.

questions.question: How does the passage connect form and measure with wisdom?
questions.answer: It says their shaping and proportions are set wisely.

questions.question: What surprising result comes from limited and similar beginnings?
questions.answer: Endless kinds of ordered and different animal forms appear.

questions.question: What is one strong proof of Allah’s oneness found in this passage?
questions.answer: One strong proof is that countless different creatures come from similar beginnings in a wise and organized way.

questions.question: What statement of belief is supported by all animals and birds in the passage?
questions.answer: The statement that only Allah is God is supported by them.

questions.question: What does the word “consensus” mean in this passage?
questions.answer: It means they all agree in pointing to the same truth.

questions.question: How does the traveler respond to this testimony?
questions.answer: He sees it and understands it completely.

questions.question: What are two kinds of signs inside animals that are mentioned?
questions.answer: Their senses and powers are mentioned.

questions.question: What are two kinds of body signs outside animals that are mentioned?
questions.answer: Their limbs and organs are mentioned.

questions.question: What do these signs tell us about how animals were made?
questions.answer: They tell us animals were made in an ordered and meaningful way.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the role of purpose in creation?
questions.answer: Purpose is part of how creatures are distinguished and beautified.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the role of wisdom in creation?
questions.answer: Wisdom is part of how creatures are measured and shaped.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the number of animal forms?
questions.answer: Their forms are extremely many and cannot be fully counted.

questions.question: What comparison is made between the beginnings of creatures and their final forms?
questions.answer: Their beginnings are alike and limited, but their final forms are many and different.

questions.question: If a student had to say the main idea in one sentence, what could they say?
questions.answer: The many ordered and beautiful kinds of animals and birds all show Allah’s power, wisdom, and oneness.
